Unit 1 Assessment

Apply what you've learned • 4 exercises • ~15 minutes

This assessment tests your ability to apply Unit 1 concepts, not just recall them. You'll sort activities, analyze scenarios, and match concepts to the funnel.

Exercise 3 of 4
Scenario: The Urgent Battlecard
25 points

📋 Scenario

Your sales director messages you at 2pm: "We're going head-to-head with Competitor X tomorrow morning. Can you get me a battlecard by end of day?"

In the past, this would take you 6-8 hours. You have 4 hours. Using the 10x PMM approach from Unit 1, what's your best workflow?
